name: dsh-no-right-sidebar
description: Local persistent Web UI patch: disable loading of the right Sidebar plugins (ui-sidebar-right and its two tab providers ui-sidebar-textpreview / ui-sidebar-files). Because ui-chat injects the `sidebarRight` service and cordis parks any plugin whose injected service is missing, this package also provides a minimal no-op `sidebarRight` stub so chat stays alive while the right Sidebar (panel, expand button, tabs) is fully removed. TypeScript: host half index.ts (type stripping), browser half src/client.ts -> lib/client.js (esbuild).
